vulnerability.explanation: The code computes a write address within the section buffer as contents + (int_rel.r_vaddr - input_section->vma) and passes it to _bfd_relocate_contents without validating that int_rel.r_vaddr lies within the bounds of the section. A crafted object with a relocation whose r_vaddr is outside [input_section->vma, input_section->vma + section_size) can cause _bfd_relocate_contents to write beyond the contents buffer, leading to a heap buffer overflow.
